general_information.Syllabus Name: Visual tool 3D_ Giới thiệu tính năng phần mềm 3D
general_information.Description: This course provides knowledge of working with Nurbs, polygon Modeling, character building topology, hardsurface modeling, blocking, advanced UV, working with camera completing a project.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities > - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class > - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose > - Read the textbook in advance > - Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment. >

description: This course provides knowledge of working with Nurbs, polygon Modeling, character building topology, hardsurface modeling, blocking, advanced UV, working with camera completing a project.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand two main skills nurbs, pologon and topology
Understand the strengths of each method
Apply the theory to shape the hand and foot
Apply the theory to shape the head
Apply the theory to shape the body
Students will be able to model, UV, assign the material, the character clothing
Students can skills in analysis and problem solving; Proficient in presentation and teamwork skills.
